object.description: Point MELLON_TECTONIC at a stand-in typesetter and MELLON_DRAWIO at a stand-in draw.io; both print lines to standard output and write their output file. Start mellon-mcp as a process with its own pipes (not the SDK client, which may drop bad lines). Export a document that has a figure. Expected: each line on the server's standard output parses as a JSON-RPC message, and the stand-ins' text doesn't appear.
